name: Flowering Nightshade
source:
Almost five years have passed since Himeka sought friendship and romance at Solana Academy. She and her friends have grown now, and have to face their adult responsibilities. As they mature, Himeka seeks to further her bonds with her friends... and perhaps find love if she hasn't already.

As a direct sequel to Blooming Nightshade, Flowering Nightshade continues the lighthearted romance story that began there. Himeka may start the game in a relationship from the first game or seek a new romance in her transition to adulthood.

This game is developed with Android phones in mind, but can also be played on PC.

[From [url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/flowering-nightshade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
自从希梅卡在索拉纳学院寻求友谊和浪漫以来，已经过去了近五年。她和她的朋友们现在已经长大了，必须面对成年人的责任。随着他们的成熟，姬花寻求进一步加深与朋友们的联系……也许她还没有找到爱情。

作为《龙葵花》的直接续集，《龙葵花》延续了从那里开始的轻松浪漫的故事。姬花可能会从第一款游戏开始就开始恋爱，或者在成年后寻求新的恋情。

该游戏专为Android手机开发，但也可以在PC上玩。

[来自[url=https://jackkel-dragon.itch.io/flowering-nightshade]Itch.io[/url]]
